description: 國道服務區充電樁營運資訊 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部高速公路局. 國道服務區充電樁每月使用總次數、國道服務區充電樁每月每車使用時間、國道服務區充電樁每月每站使用總度數等3筆資料集整併. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部高速公路局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
